propositions: No error or warning signal exists when an expected verification block is absent after Pass-2 runs, despite verification blocks being routinely recorded on decided LLM-tier findings
The original premise that findings lack verification was disproven by audit: 3583 of 3673 recorded code-review findings (97.5%) carry a verification block with {binary, severity_attributes}

A verification_recorded metric must be added to coverage[metrics] to signal when Pass-2 ran but LLM-tier decided findings lack verification blocks, scoped to exclude DET-tier and indeterminate/no-verification findings to avoid standing false alarms

The field-spread in build_payload (_with_norm_ids) already preserves verification blocks through to sidecar payloads; a regression test must pin this behavior to prevent silent regress to field-selection
